spl_product_data_elements: Dry Skin Healing Petrolatum CERESIN MINERAL OIL PANTHENOL GLYCERIN .ALPHA.-BISABOLOL, (+)- LANOLIN ALCOHOLS PETROLATUM PETROLATUM
indications_and_usage: Uses temporarily protects minor: cuts, scrapes, burns. temporarily protects and helps relieve chapped or cracked skin and lips. helps protect from the drying effects of wind and cold weather.
warnings: Warnings For external use only When using this product Do not get in eyes. Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens symptoms last more than 7 days or clear up and occur within a few days. Do not use on Deep or puncture wounds animal bites. serious burns Keep out of reach of children If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
